title: Abandoned Pool Rebuilt in Minutes ⏱️
caption: Same pool, completely new life 🔨 👉 Share with a friend, subscribe for a new makeover every day, and comment if you want more like this!
narration: Would you believe someone just gave up on this pool? Bit by bit, the crew scooped out the mud and leaves, repaired the cracked walls, and laid new stone around the edge.
